note: Sends escalation email on sensor status transition. Config monitoring_mail.settings: mail (recipient), severities (list, default [CRITICAL]). Fields injected into the base settings form; mail sent from hook_monitoring_run_sensors. Baseline: submodule not enabled. Medium cases enable it, seed known settings, read them back; hard cases configure the recipient / add a severity, verified against live config (reset enables + clears the key). Grounded in real config keys.

evals.prompt: What does the monitoring_mail submodule do, and when does it actually send an email?
evals.expected_output: It sends escalation email when a sensor's result transitions into a configured bad status (severity). It hooks hook_monitoring_run_sensors after each run and mails on status change into a configured severity.

evals.prompt: In which config object does monitoring_mail store the recipient address and the severities that trigger email, and where do you edit them in the UI?
evals.expected_output: Stored in monitoring_mail.settings (keys: mail, severities). Edited on the base Monitoring settings form at /admin/config/system/monitoring/settings (fields injected via hook_form_monitoring_settings_alter).

evals.prompt: By default, which sensor status severity triggers a monitoring_mail escalation email?
evals.expected_output: By default severities is [CRITICAL], so mail is sent on transition to CRITICAL. You can add WARNING to also mail on warnings.

evals.prompt: monitoring_mail is configured on this site. Inspect the live monitoring_mail.settings and report the recipient email address that escalation mail is sent to.
Inspect the live monitoring_mail configuration on this site and list which sensor severities currently trigger an escalation email.
evals.expected_output: severities is [CRITICAL, WARNING] on this site, so both trigger mail (monitoring_mail.settings:severities).

evals.prompt: Configure monitoring_mail so that escalation email is sent to ops@task.test. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: monitoring_mail.settings:mail is set to a non-empty recipient address (e.g. ops@task.test), via the Monitoring settings form or drush cset monitoring_mail.settings mail ops@task.test.

evals.prompt: Right now I only get emailed about critical site problems. I also want to be emailed about warnings. Please make warnings trigger the alert emails too.
evals.expected_output: monitoring_mail.settings:severities now includes WARNING (in addition to CRITICAL), so warning transitions also trigger mail.
